Author: Dalagab Group
Name: Omega
Punchline: A curated, searchable marketplace for Dalamud plugins.
Description: Omega by the Dalagab Group is a visual Dalamud plugin marketplace that includes Dalamud's official/default catalogue, a preferred hash-checked downloadable catalog database, automatic local-source fallback, repository/author/tag filters, stale-repository suppression, API compatibility badges, explicit duplicate-source provenance, repository-choice installation, Spotlight information cards, Dalamud collection folders with delegated on/off control, and package installation delegated to Dalamud.
